mapper.select: select * from eng_article_level_progress where user_id=#{userId} and article_id=#{articleId} and level_no=#{levelNo}
select * from eng_article_level_progress where user_id=#{userId} and article_id=#{articleId} order by level_no
select count(*) from eng_article_level_progress where article_id=#{articleId} and level_no=#{levelNo}
select coalesce(max(level_no),0) from eng_article_level_progress where article_id=#{articleId}
mapper.insert: insert into eng_article_level_progress(user_id,article_id,level_no,best_score,highest_stars,completed_by_known_words, create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values(#{userId},#{articleId},#{levelNo},#{bestScore},#{highestStars},0,#{createBy},now(),#{updateBy},now()) on duplicate key update best_score=greatest(best_score,values(best_score)), highest_stars=greatest(highest_stars,values(highest_stars)),update_by=values(update_by),update_time=now()

insert into eng_article_level_progress(user_id,article_id,level_no,best_score,highest_stars,completed_by_known_words, create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values(#{userId},#{articleId},#{levelNo},0,0,1,#{createBy},now(),#{updateBy},now()) on duplicate key update completed_by_known_words=1,update_by=values(update_by),update_time=now()
